R code for a paper tentatively titled “Hidden Attitudes? Reassessing Support for Same-Sex Marriage in Japan through a List Experiment”

# Data Analysis

```{r}
#penalize excessive significant figures
options(digits = 3)

#prevent scientific notation
options(scipen = 10)

#packages used in this analysis
library(tidyverse)
library(list)
library(tableone)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

#set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)
```

```{r}
#import raw data
data <- read_csv("data/rawdata.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "CP932"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#recode variables

#treatment group vs. control group
table(data$cellname)
table(data$cid)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(treat = case_when(
    cid >= 1  & cid <= 10 ~ 1,
    cid >= 11 & cid <= 20 ~ 0))

100*prop.table(table(data$cellname, data$treat), margin = 1)

#direct question
table(data$q10)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(direct = recode(q10,
                         `1` = 1,
                         `2` = 0))

100*prop.table(table(data$q10, data$direct), margin = 1)
```

```{r}
#convert the format
data <- as.data.frame(data)
```

```{r}
#delete satisficers
table(data$q7_5)
100*prop.table(table(data$q7_5))

data <- data %>%
  filter(q7_5 == 2)
```

```{r}
#check covariate balance
vars <- c("q5", "AGE", "q4", "q8")
table1 <- CreateTableOne(
     vars = vars,
     strata = "treat",
     data = data,
     factorVars = c("q5", "q4", "q8"))
print(table1)

#check design effects
ict.test(y = data$q9_1fa, treat = data$treat, J = 4)

#check ceiling and floor effects
table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 0])
100*prop.table(table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 0]) )

table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 1])
100*prop.table(table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 1]))
```

```{r}
#calculate list experiment difference in means
diff.in.means.results <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = data, 
                  treat = "treat", J=4, method = "lm")
summary(diff.in.means.results)

#direct question estimate
p <- mean(data$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

#sample size
n <- sum(!is.na(data$direct))

#standard error
se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)

p
se
```

```{r}
#subgroup analysis
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    gender    = case_when(q5 == 1 ~ "Men", q5 == 2 ~ "Women", q5 == 3 ~ "NonBinary"),
    age_group = case_when(AGE < 40 ~ "Younger", AGE < 60 ~ "Middle", AGE < 70 ~ "Older"),
    edu       = case_when(q4 <= 4 ~ "LessBA", q4 %in% 5:6 ~ "BAorAbove"),  # q4 == 7 は NA
    political = case_when(q8 <= 3 ~ "Liberal", q8 == 4 ~ "Center", q8 >= 5 ~ "Conservative")
  )

est_ie <- function(d, B = 2000, boot = TRUE, exact_direct = FALSE) {
  y1 <- d$q9_1fa[d$treat == 1]; y0 <- d$q9_1fa[d$treat == 0]
  dd <- d$direct[d$treat == 0]
  p  <- mean(dd); se_d <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / length(dd))
  l  <- mean(y1) - mean(y0)
  se_l <- sqrt(var(y1) / length(y1) + var(y0) / length(y0))
  diff <- l - p
  se_diff <- sqrt(se_l^2 + se_d^2)

  # 直接質問のCI
  d_ci <- if (exact_direct) binom.test(sum(dd), length(dd))$conf.int
          else c(p - 1.96 * se_d, p + 1.96 * se_d)

  se_boot <- NA_real_
  if (boot) {
    bs <- replicate(B, {
      b <- d[sample(nrow(d), replace = TRUE), ]
      mean(b$q9_1fa[b$treat == 1]) - mean(b$q9_1fa[b$treat == 0]) -
        mean(b$direct[b$treat == 0])
    })
    se_boot <- sd(bs, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  tibble(n_direct = length(dd), direct_est = p, direct_se = se_d,
         direct_lo = d_ci[1], direct_hi = d_ci[2],
         n_list = nrow(d), list_est = l, list_se = se_l,
         list_lo = l - 1.96 * se_l, list_hi = l + 1.96 * se_l,
         diff = diff, diff_se = se_diff, diff_se_boot = se_boot,
         p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(diff / se_diff)))
}

res <- bind_rows(
  Overall      = est_ie(data),
  Men          = est_ie(filter(data, gender == "Men")),
  Women        = est_ie(filter(data, gender == "Women")),
  Younger      = est_ie(filter(data, age_group == "Younger")),
  Middle       = est_ie(filter(data, age_group == "Middle")),
  Older        = est_ie(filter(data, age_group == "Older")),
  LessBA       = est_ie(filter(data, edu == "LessBA")),
  BAorAbove    = est_ie(filter(data, edu == "BAorAbove")),
  Liberal      = est_ie(filter(data, political == "Liberal")),
  Center       = est_ie(filter(data, political == "Center")),
  Conservative = est_ie(filter(data, political == "Conservative")),
  .id = "subgroup")
res
```

```{r}
#plot the results

#Code for this figure was developed with assistance from Claude (Anthropic); the underlying analysis and all reported estimates are from the authors' own statistical models

# ---- 1. 右パネル用データ(差と95%CI、単位は pp) ---------------------------
diff_data <- res %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "subgroup") %>%
  mutate(
    p_value  = 2 * pnorm(-abs(diff / diff_se)),
    stars    = case_when(p_value < .001 ~ "***", p_value < .01 ~ "**",
                         p_value < .05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""),
    est      = diff * 100,
    lo       = (diff - 1.96 * diff_se) * 100,
    hi       = (diff + 1.96 * diff_se) * 100,
    category = factor(category,
                      levels = c("Overall", "Gender", "Age", "Education", "Ideology")),
    label    = factor(label, levels = levels(plot_data$label))   # 左と同じ並び
  )

# ---- 2. 共通のテーマ -----------------------------------------------------
base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.spacing      = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    panel.border       = element_rect(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.key         = element_blank(),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# ---- 3. 左:direct vs. list ----------------------------------------------
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Direct question", "List experiment")))
p_left <- plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = label, shape = measure)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = pd,
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black",
                orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(position = pd, size = 2.2, fill = "white",
             color = "black", stroke = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(x = hi, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", est)), position = pd,
            hjust = -0.15, size = 2.7, family = "sans", show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("List experiment" = 16, "Direct question" = 1),
    breaks = c("Direct question", "List experiment")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
                     labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 20), "%"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.8)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 105)) +
  labs(x = "Estimated support (%)", y = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 9, face = "plain"))

# ---- 4. 右:差(list − direct) -------------------------------------------
p_right <- diff_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4,
                color = "black", orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(shape = 15, size = 2.2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(x = hi, label = sprintf("%.1f%s", est, stars)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 2.7, family = "sans") +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-30, 30, 10)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.8)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-35, 35)) +
  labs(x = "Difference: list \u2212 direct (pp)", y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

# ---- 5. 結合 -------------------------------------------------------------
p <- (p_left + p_right) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure 1. Support for same-sex marriage in Japan:\nDirect question vs. list experiment",
    caption = paste0(
      "Note. List-experiment estimates are differences in mean item counts between treatment and control groups (N = 1,928);\n",
      "direct-question estimates are the proportion of support in the control group (n = 958).\n",
      "Error bars indicate 95% confidence intervals. Respondents with 'other' education (n = 2) are excluded from the education panel.\n",
      "Non-binary respondents (n = 9) are included in the overall estimate but not shown separately (see text).\n",
      "Right panel: difference (list \u2212 direct) in percentage points; SE = sqrt(SE_list^2 + SE_direct^2).\n",
      "* p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001."),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic", color = "black", hjust = 0)
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p

ggsave("direct_vs_list.png", p, path = "figure", width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 320)
```
